page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated bare-metal instance type optimized for high-performance computing, AI inference, graphics rendering, and machine learning workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features dedicated compute allocation powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz with 128 vCPUs. System memory totals 512 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU allocation.

The server incorporates eight integrated NVIDIA A10 GPUs delivering a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. This multi-GPU acceleration array enables parallel processing capabilities suitable for large-scale computer vision, AI model execution, and video encoding workflows. Data transfers across external systems and remote storage pools are facilitated by a high-throughput network interface rated at a baseline bandwidth of 160 Gbps.

The instance profile includes no local ephemeral storage, requiring attached network volumes or block storage for persistent data operations. Its high GPU density relative to system memory makes it a specialized asset where cost efficiency is driven by parallel processing throughput across multiple acceleration units rather than localized disk caching. Primary workload fits include deep learning inference, distributed graphics processing, media transcoding, and compute-heavy scientific simulations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance designed for parallel computing, AI inference, and intensive graphics workloads. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B x86_64 processor clocked at 2.9 GHz, it provides 128 dedicated vCPUs along with 512 GB of system memory, yielding a 4.0 GB per vCPU memory ratio. Hardware acceleration is driven by eight NVIDIA A10 GPUs offering a total of 192 GB VRAM. Network communication is supported by a 160 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance features no local storage, relying on attached network storage for data persistence. This high resource density profile offers efficient scale for compute tasks requiring high GPU concurrency. The server is well suited for enterprise AI model inference, deep learning pipelines, media encoding, and high-performance graphics rendering.
